name: Pattern Machine A — Jacquard Punch-Card Loom
description: An interactive sci-fi weaving machine whose program is a physical PUNCH CARD. The player toggles pegs on the NxN card mounted on the machine head (touch-toggle via hands, or the PUNCH/GROUP/WEAVE/CLEAR buttons), and the loom weaves the corresponding wallpaper-group carpet LIVE — scrolling it continuously out over the feed roller onto the floor. Combines pattern_maker_station's interactivity with pattern_loom's machine vocabulary: edit the card, the woven output updates the same frame. Reuses WallpaperGroups.get_symmetric_color for live per-cell tiling.
theoreticalGrounding: The Jacquard loom was the first programmable machine — the pattern was never woven by hand, it was punched into a card and read by a rule. Here the punch card IS the motif grid and the 17 wallpaper groups ARE the weaving programs; a handful of toggled pegs becomes endless fabric.

pattern_machine_a.name: Pattern Machine A — Jacquard Punch-Card Loom
pattern_machine_a.description: Dark machine frame with side posts, top crossbeam, glowing amber warp threads, a pulsing weave bar and feed roller. On the head sits an interactive NxN punch card: touch a peg to toggle it (empty <-> punched color), PUNCH cycles the paint color, GROUP cycles the 17 symmetry programs, WEAVE re-rolls a fresh motif, CLEAR blanks it. Every edit re-weaves the live wallpaper carpet that scrolls out across the floor. DNA: group (p1..p6m), palette, motif_seed, card_size, density, carpet_repeats.
pattern_machine_a.qfep_connection: F_order: the punch card as the first programmable substrate — constraint, punched by hand, multiplied by symmetry into endless fabric.
